visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 current portable views, including the retained1024×640 summary. The mapped stepped square envelope has warm inward-battered walls,narrow dark fields,a pale roof and cusped parapet,broad gold central dome with a dark drum band,four smaller gold cupolas,and four slender pale minarets with flared collars and pointed caps. The west entrance has brass door fields and original coarse blue-green panels. The dome spring and detail cameras were revised after first inspection. The review fixture ground datum now matches the negative local floor. Doors and recesses are opaque exterior abstractions;there is no claimed navigable interior. Fine historic calligraphy,mosaic art,site walls,landscaping and engineering are omitted.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected 11 current shared-material/geographic views,including the placement overlay and complete entrance at the corrected review ground datum. Six existing256² graphs supply raw sandstone,raw/weathered limestone,membrane,bronze and ceramic;seven merged roles include local opaque glazing. Metric UVs and linear tints;no embedded images or unique atlas. Shared graphs are read once and eviction disposes model geometry. The outer replacement hull encloses the named main hall and separate corner bases;five occupied ground masks avoid removing the whole grounds. All10 independent nearby building records remain unchanged. Flat placement views establish approximate pose and subtraction,not measured terrain contact.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected27 current medium-fi views:Economy/High,noon/late light,street/block/skyline,silhouette,six details,four matched LODs and four transitions. All levels retain the broad gold dome,the battered stepped mass and four pointed minarets. Skyline deliberately drops facade recesses and parapets and has faceted roof/caps;district adds the dark vertical rhythm,roof band and simple entry panels;street/closeup add sparse grids,door divisions,cusps,ribs and more curved roof/cap forms. Whole cameras keep the complete towers;detail views intentionally crop other sections. Terrain and procedural neighbors are illustrative. Physical laptop/phone/tablet and full-city timing remain unmeasured.

The separate grounds buildings,boundary walls,landscaping,street,interiors,historic artwork,inscriptions and engineering are excluded. The2019 distant exterior,2014 entrance detail and2005 full exterior guide the characteristic colors and forms;they do not establish present condition. No invented exact measurements,inscriptions or copied photo textures are claimed. Interiors,engineering,surveyed grades and complete current condition remain unverified or omitted.
